info.name: Service Bay
info.description: All HTTP APIs for Service Bay. 'Full flow' runs the business flows end to end with assertions (see postman/README.md). In the per-service folders, create/register requests store IDs (customerId, vehicleId, billId) into collection variables for later requests.

item.name: Full flow

item.name: Payment Service
item.description: payment-service (Spring Boot, :8085). The only service that talks to Stripe. Create/cancel are internal (called by billing); test-confirm and sync are handy for manual testing.

request.description: Stripe test-mode keys only (403 with a live key). Confirms with a Stripe test card and applies the result like the webhook would, so no browser or `stripe listen` is needed.
The payment stays PENDING with failureReason set; the customer can retry.
Re-reads the PaymentIntent from Stripe and applies its status (recovers a missed webhook).
Normally only billing-service calls this. Idempotent per billingPaymentId.
